rule: Pick tools from the target tree. A catalog row is not proof mutation is installed. If mutation is n/a, say so — do not invent a score.

js.unit: bun test | npm test | pnpm test | yarn test
js.mutation: bunx stryker run | npx stryker run
js.notes: Prefer bun when bun.lock exists. Stryker is if-present; a missing config is n/a, not a fake 80.

python.notes: mutmut or cosmic-ray. Score is project policy.

go.notes: No default Go mutator. Fail closed: mutation n/a.
